hotels.description: Elegant touches and effortless charm make your escape to the stylish voco St John’s Solihull memorable from the moment you arrive. Indulge in international cuisine made with local, seasonal produce at Brasserie six5one, sip European wines at the onsite bar, dive into the indoor pool, enjoy a relaxing session in the sauna or hit the treadmill in the health club. Outside of the hotel, explore the National Exhibition Centre, Warwick Castle or mouthwatering Cadbury World.
